findings.description: The overlap check uses <= instead of <, so intervals that touch at the endpoint are considered overlapping, contrary to the specification.
findings.evidence: For input a=(1,2) and b=(2,3), the contract requires overlaps((1,2),(2,3)) to be False, but candidate.overlaps returns True because max(1,2)=2 and min(2,3)=2, and 2 <= 2 evaluates to True.

review.summary: Candidate implementation incorrectly considers touching endpoints as overlapping, violating the contract that half‑open intervals touch at endpoints without overlap.
